name: Pathfinder Bot
description: Inspired by: FB Mod | PFP by: NroGD

segment-steps.name: Search segment length (steps)
segment-steps.description: The most physics steps the bot plans per segment. Smaller is faster but more likely to get stuck.

search-speed.name: Max search speed
search-speed.description: Highest game speed while searching. The bot slows itself down when needed so it never misses a chance to press. Higher can lag or crash on weak phones.

show-window-tally.name: Show frame window tally
show-window-tally.description: Show a tally of input gaps (1, 2, 3, 4, 5-6, 7-8, 9-12 steps) during playback.

window-ding.name: Ding on every counted window
window-ding.description: Play a ding for every counted window, with a different pitch for each window size.

safe-mode.name: Auto safe mode
safe-mode.description: Blocks the level from being completed while the bot searches or plays. The level restarts instead.
